text:
anya: Quick sync on a compact hover-first roles layout in the invite drawer. Idea: single-line role rows with hover/focus preview on desktop, tap-to-preview on mobile (bottom sheet). Figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-hover :link

gabe: Like hover for desktop. Mobile bottom sheet should include a clear Assign CTA and not block primary actions. Consider +N overflow for many roles.

rui: Accessibility checklist high-level: rows are focusable (role=row), Arrow keys move focus, Enter/Space open details. Use `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` for the detail region and `aria-live=polite` to announce previews (e.g., "Preview: Viewer role, can view projects and audit logs"). Truncated names need `aria-label` with full name + summary.

sarah: Copy: teaser: "Viewer — read only". Preview header: "Viewer role details" with bullets: "View projects", "View logs & audit entries", "Cannot invite". SSO note: show lock icon + text "SSO required to assign" when applicable. For disabling SSO enforcement modal draft: "Disabling SSO enforcement may allow users to sign in without your IdP. To confirm, type your org name: <org-name>" Primary CTA: "Disable enforcement" Secondary: "Cancel". Legal will review.

ken: Telemetry: `invite.hover_preview_show`, `invite.preview_assign`, `invite.overflow_open`, `org.sso.enforcement_changed`. Also record `invite.time_to_send_ms`. For audit nav: if user goes to Audit Logs from invite, preserve role filter via `?role=viewer&src=invite` and show banner "Applied filter: Viewer (from Invite)" with a keyboard-focusable clear button.

design-bot: design-assets: uploaded `invite/compact-hover/v1` frames to Figma. :white_check_mark:

anya: Next steps: Rui to write a short ARIA spec (Tue EOD), Gabe to add mobile bottom sheet mock (Wed), Sarah to finalize SSO modal copy and ping legal, Ken to add telemetry tickets. We'll run a quick mobile A/B if overflow >40% in the prototype. Thanks! :sparkles:
